summary: Bearer is unaffected by Magical abilities of every School; when the bearer dies they are Cursed.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Magical abilities from any School; the text does not limit this to harmful abilities.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Drawback: upon death the bearer is Cursed (Cursed persists after death and is removed on respawn).

clarifications.text: Protection from Magic does not interact with the other Enchantments the bearer wears (it does not block or remove them).

open_questions: E1 read literally blocks beneficial Magical abilities too (healing, revival, other Magical Enchantments cast later); the text does not say 'hostile'.

N1 'does not interact with other Enchantments worn by the bearer' is read as: Enchantments already worn keep working and are not blocked; the text does not say whether new Magical Enchantments can be placed on the bearer.
